India records 573 fresh COVID-19 cases, 2 deaths in 24 hours; active count stands at 4,565
The Economic Times
3460000 subscribers

India recorded 573 fresh cases of Covid and two deaths in the last 24 hours, the Union Ministry of Health and Family Welfare said on Tuesday. According to the Ministry, the new cases take the total number of active cases to 4,565. It said that two deaths were reported, one each from Haryana and Karnataka.
